text:
alex: Heads-up — canary promotion was auto-paused by deploybot. Staging CI started failing ~10m ago.

deploybot: Promotion paused (canary): 2 failing jobs. Reason: runner-5 OOM; artifact fetch mismatch (cache key flip). Auto-rollback disabled per policy.

maria: Ugh. I see repeated OOMs on runner-5 during parallel test matrix, memory spike at test-worker spawn.

chris: Also seeing a bunch of 404s from the artifact proxy for the wheel blob. Headers show X-Cache-Key: changed between attempts.

jen: Is this the same cache key-rotation we saw last week? That one was caused by the build metadata including transient timestamp.

alex: Looks similar but logs show stable build id. The cache key flip is around the multipart upload finalization step. Attaching snippet:

```
[artifact-proxy] GET /blobs/wheels/abcd1234 -> 404
[cache] key=v2:pkg:wheels:abcd1234:meta-20260321 -> miss
[proxy] retry -> key=v2:pkg:wheels:abcd1234 -> hit
```

chris: So some requests include the extra "meta-<date>" suffix, others don't. Race between upload finalizer and cache indexer?

sre-ops: Initial triage: runner oom likely unrelated but coincident. Suggest two parallel actions: 1) pin canary to last-green image to unblock release window, 2) reproduce upload finalizer race locally using staged uploads.

maria: For runner OOM we can throttle matrix concurrency on staging for now (reduce PARALLEL=6 -> 3). That should avoid immediate OOMs.

jen: Pinning to last-green is safest for SLA. Would need manual promote via deploybot: `deploybot promote --image sha:ef12... --reason "pin after staging CI flake"`

alex: Agree. Release window closes in 90m. I prefer pin + postmortem rather than chasing a flaky indexer during the window. If we pin we must include an explicit release-note entry and communicate to customers.

release-manager: Agreed. Please add entry to release notes: "Pinned runtime image used for canary promotion due to transient staging CI artifact race; will attempt revalidation post-window." Also flag for follow-up on Monday.

chris: I'm going to fork a local indexer and run the staged upload finalizer loop to reproduce. If I can reproduce I'll open a PR for an atomic index update.

deploybot: Manual promote available. To confirm run `deploybot promote --image sha:ef12ab34 --env staging --by @alex`.

alex: Doing the promote now.

alex: deploybot promote command issued — waiting on confirmation.

deploybot: Promotion queued by alex. Canary promotion initiated against image sha:ef12ab34. Canary health checks started.

maria: Lowering PARALLEL on staging CI to 3 for the rest of the day. Will monitor runner memory.

sre-ops: Noted. If OOMs re-occur assign to @chris on pager.

chris: Will follow up on indexer repro. If I can repro I'll attach logs and tag eng-releases.

release-manager: Good call on pin. After canary confirms, schedule a canary-to-prod decision at +2h in case we need rollback.

alex: Canary healthy checks passed. Canary promotion completed. Updating release notes and closing the promo incident.

jen: Thanks. Please don't forget the postmortem and an owner for the indexer fix.

chris: I'll own the indexer investigation.

alex: Thread wrap: pin done, PARALLEL reduced, indexer investigation assigned to chris. We'll reopen if anything else pops. :white_check_mark:
